Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — notes, decisions, and owners (recap)

Team — thanks for a productive checkpoint this morning. Below are the concise meeting notes, explicit action items with owners, and the proposed gates/timeline. Please reply with any corrections.

Decisions made
- Move the performance gate to a blocking decision on 2026-03-29 (we'll run the 24h load window before then).
- Security evidence: Redwood to provide audit-log sample + architecture diagram by 2026-03-26.
- Procurement: Acme still targeting PO week of 2026-04-05 contingent on successful performance gate.

Action items (owner — due)
1) Run 24h load test (Dev Patel — due 2026-03-26) — scope: steady-state 100 req/s, short bursts to 150 req/s; capture P95/P99 latency and error rate. Attachment: load_test_plan.md (draft).
2) Share baseline eval prompts and expected quality pass/fail rules (Elena / Acme — due 2026-03-24).
3) Provide security evidence: sample audit logs + role separation diagram (Grace O'Connor — due 2026-03-26).
4) Prepare canary rollout plan for dedicated capacity if gate passes (Laura Bennett — due 2026-03-30).
5) Finance/check pricing for committed capacity option (Rishi — due 2026-03-25).

Risks & mitigations
- If the load test shows P95 > 250ms, trigger fallback: reduce batch size and use model-quantized variant; we will pre-warm KV cache.
- Procurement delay --> propose a temporary hosted cap with isolated data path to start evaluation.

Attachments referenced: Acme_MAP_v2.xlsx, security_q_supplement.pdf, load_test_plan.md
Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/Acme/MAP-2026-03-22

Proposed agenda for next checkpoint (2026-03-29)
- Load test results review (15m)
- Security evidence signoff (10m)
- Procurement readiness (10m)
- Rollout/canary plan & timeline (10m)

Thanks — please flag anything missing.
